shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone slab/pillar
figures oriented on a vertical monolithic surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief zoomorphic imagery on upright stone, including profile creatures with open-jawed heads and visible limbs, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a dense, flat, interlocking curvilinear glyph-like composition filling the whole slab with abstracted scroll and mask motifs, while B shows a few isolated, comparatively naturalistic animals with modelled bodies floating on an otherwise blank field — different conventions of abstraction, density and layout.
